DDoS高防实例的ID。

description.en:
The ID of the instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstanceIds](~~157459~~) operation to query the IDs of all instances.

description.zh:
白名单IP的详细信息，使用JSON格式的字符串表述，具体结构如下。
- **src：String**类型，必选，白名单IP。
description.en:
The IP addresses that you want to manage. This parameter is a JSON string. This parameter is a JSON string. The string contains the following field:

*   **src**: the IP address. This field is required and must be of the string type.

title.zh: 删除针对DDoS高防实例的白名单IP

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddoscoo delete-auto-cc-whitelist --instance-id ddoscoo-cn-mp91j1ao0000 --whitelist src_:_1.1.1.1_,_src_:_2.2.2.2 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
